artifact_observations.reasoning: The beads exhibit an overly uniform, airbrushed matte texture with very subtle specular highlights that look slightly synthetic rather than physically rendered.
The connecting strings are largely invisible or appear to merge directly into the beads without clear entry/exit holes, suggesting slight geometric fusion typical of AI generation.
The transition between the mannequin neck and the implied shoulder area is soft and lacks sharp structural definition, though this may also be due to depth of field.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of jewelry and distinguish it from other accessories like scarves or collars.
To verify if the beads are distinct objects connected by strings or if they are fused/melted together, addressing the invisible connection points.
To assess the realism of the lighting on the matte surfaces and detect any subtle generative noise or blur artifacts.

focus_areas: Connectivity of beads (are they physically linked or floating/fused?)
Material realism (matte finish vs. plastic-looking sheen)
Mannequin geometry (is the support structure anatomically/physically plausible?)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'invisible' strings holding the beads. In AI images, these often disappear or cause beads to float. Check if the topology auditor finds disconnected components. Also, evaluate if the matte texture is consistent with real-world materials like tagua nut or matte plastic, or if it has the 'waxy' look of diffusion models.
